_comment: Keyed by repo name. Anything set here wins over auto-derived data. Fields: title, blurb, category, topics, image, url, featured, hidden.

ClearMind.title: ClearMind
ClearMind.blurb: Five minutes of thinking practice a day. Everyone gets the same puzzles on the same date, so you can compare your judgement against yesterday's and against other people's.

Habitcheck.title: Habitcheck
Habitcheck.blurb: Tick off your habits in a couple of taps and watch the streak build. Everything stays in your browser — no sign-up, works offline.

Pomodoro.title: Focus Rooms
Pomodoro.blurb: A pomodoro timer you can share. Open a room, send the link, and everyone works through the same 25 minutes together.

Breath_aurora.title: Breath Aurora
Breath_aurora.blurb: Guided breathing, mudras and short movement sequences, with a visual that paces your inhale and exhale so you don't have to count.

complete_human.title: The Complete Human
complete_human.blurb: A daily check-in across eight areas of life — body, mind, work, relationships and the rest — so progress in one doesn't quietly cost you another.

growth.title: GrowthPath
growth.blurb: A growth tracker for people who ship. Set goals across career, craft, reach and character, then log the small things that actually move them.

Transformyourlife.title: Transform Your Life
Transformyourlife.blurb: A gentle companion for changing a habit you're stuck in — daily steps, relapse-aware, and never scolding.

Addiction_test.title: Addiction Check
Addiction_test.blurb: A self-check for the modern attachments — phone, food, spending, scrolling. Scores each area so you can see which one is actually the problem.

Unmasking_sexual_engineered.title: Unmasking
Unmasking_sexual_engineered.blurb: A recovery companion for porn and compulsive habits: what's being engineered to hook you, and a practical route back to your own attention.

Pusula.title: Pusula
Pusula.blurb: A values compass for hard moments. Daily quests, a focus list, and a panic button that gives you something to do in the ten seconds that matter.

Joyofliving.title: Joy of Living
Joyofliving.blurb: A thirty-question check-in on how life is actually going, in English or Turkish. Takes five minutes, repeats weekly, and nothing leaves your device.

Howold.title: Body & Mind Age
Howold.blurb: Answer questions about how you sleep, move, feel and connect, and get an estimate of how old your body and mind are behaving — separate from your birthday.

protocol.title: Close the Ramp
protocol.blurb: A structured protocol for shutting down the on-ramps to a habit before willpower is needed. Works offline, in Turkish and English.

SwiftReader.title: SwiftReader
SwiftReader.blurb: Read faster by flashing one word at a time. Load a PDF or EPUB, keep a local library, take notes — all in the browser, nothing uploaded.

boppo.title: BopGrid
boppo.blurb: Hit the lit buttons before the timer runs out. Four modes, including one where the rule changes on you mid-game.

hexodrop.title: Hex Hive Drop
hexodrop.blurb: Tetris on a hexagonal hive that rotates under you. Gravity follows the glowing wall, so the board you were planning for keeps turning.

zombie_game.title: Zombie Tap Defense
zombie_game.blurb: Tap zombies to shoot them, survive the wave, spend the money on turrets and upgrades. Then the boss shows up.

Highorlow.title: HighLow 21
Highorlow.blurb: Higher or lower, with a card between 1 and 21 and a countdown. Make a room, share the code, and race friends for points.

Mathbomb.title: Math Bomb
Mathbomb.blurb: Answer the sum before the bomb goes off in your hands — then throw it to someone else in the room.

roulette.title: Rus Ruleti
roulette.blurb: A party game of nerve. Set the chamber count, share the room code, spin, and take turns pulling the trigger.

newbrotato.title: Nova Arena 3D
newbrotato.blurb: A rogue-survivor arena in 3D: waves close in, you pick an upgrade each level, and a boss meter fills while you dash between them.

3dbrotato.title: Nova Arena 3D · Jump Build
3dbrotato.blurb: The jumping variant of Nova Arena — same wave survival, but the terrain matters and you vault obstacles instead of dashing past them.

Brotatohtml.title: Nova Arena
Brotatohtml.blurb: The original flat-plane version: one endless world, twin-stick movement, and upgrades every level. A single HTML file.

Minetogether.title: DeepMine Online
Minetogether.blurb: Send miners down through layers of rock, upgrade the drills and the elevator, and climb a shared leaderboard — or dig solo when you're offline.

Tournament.title: Tournament
Tournament.blurb: Type in the teams, pick a format, and get a bracket you can share by link and update as results come in. Built for someone running an event from their phone.

World.title: World
World.blurb: Walk, drive, sail or fly through a stylised version of the actual planet — real buildings, roads, rivers and terrain pulled from OpenStreetMap.

fractaluni.title: Fractal Universe
fractaluni.blurb: Fly out to a galaxy, pick a star, drop into its system, then land and walk on a planet that generates its terrain, water and wildlife as you arrive.

pru_simulation_engine.title: PRU Universe
pru_simulation_engine.blurb: A physics sandbox built on a lattice of cells that each hold mass and geometry state, so you can watch structure emerge from local rules.

cosmic-sandbox.title: Cosmic Sandbox
cosmic-sandbox.blurb: Build a star system, get the conditions right for life, and keep it going as the universe expands around you.

Consciousparticle.title: Conscious Particle
Consciousparticle.blurb: Start as a mote drifting between gravity wells, absorb energy, and evolve into something more complicated. Spore, compressed into a browser tab.

earth-sim.title: Earth Sim
earth-sim.blurb: Take charge of a country and see what your policy choices do to its people, its economy and its neighbours over the following decades.

Scaleuniverse.title: Scale of the Universe
Scaleuniverse.blurb: Zoom continuously from below the atom to the edge of the observable universe, and see where you sit on the way past.

code-trainer.title: Python Interview Trainer
code-trainer.blurb: Learn Python in small steps, then practise on interview-style problems. Your code actually runs in the browser, so there's nothing to install.

RisksofAI.title: AIAware
RisksofAI.blurb: A course on what AI can and can't do, where it goes wrong, and how to work with it. Badges as you go, no account needed.

marriagequiz.title: Hayırlısı
marriagequiz.blurb: A compatibility questionnaire built on marriage research rather than vibes — designed to show you your own assumptions before you commit to someone.

Quizroom.title: Ortak Quiz
Quizroom.blurb: Everyone in the room writes questions first, then you all take the quiz at once and see the scoreboard. Good for classrooms and long car journeys.

housing.title: The Housing Crisis
housing.blurb: Why housing costs what it does, with the data behind each claim and calculators that let you check the argument against your own city.

Animalwellfare.title: The True Cost
Animalwellfare.blurb: What US farm animal welfare law actually requires, where the gaps are, and what closing them would cost. Presented as a readable paper with the sources attached.

dontforget.title: Don't Forget
dontforget.blurb: A documented account of systemic abuse and the institutional failures around it, assembled so the record stays findable.

Climatechange.title: Climate Reality Dashboard
Climatechange.blurb: Pick your city and see its real temperature trend, air quality, rainfall and flood risk — the climate argument, localised to where you live.

loveofwisdom.title: Love of Wisdom
loveofwisdom.blurb: A map of philosophy organised by question rather than by philosopher, so you can see where thinkers who never met landed on the same answer.

Truth-Knowability-Ethics-Benefit.title: Truth · Ethics · Benefit
Truth-Knowability-Ethics-Benefit.blurb: A working tool for deliberating hard decisions: weigh what's true, what's right and what actually helps, and see where those three pull apart.

hakikat_ucgeni.title: Hakikat Üçgeni
hakikat_ucgeni.blurb: A long study, in Turkish, of the three classical sources of temptation — the self, the world, and the devil — and how they reinforce each other.

dua.title: Duʿāʾ of the Prophets
dua.blurb: Sixty-three supplications from the Qur'an and authenticated Sunnah, each with the Arabic, a transliteration, a translation and the moment it was said.

qibla.title: Qibla Room Map
qibla.blurb: Find the qibla without a working compass: use your location and a landmark in the room to line the direction up properly.

Masjid.title: Masjid
Masjid.blurb: Prayer times and congregation times for your local mosque, set by location and shareable as a link.

flashes.title: The Flashes
flashes.blurb: An English-language companion to Lem'alar by Said Nursî — full text, search, cross-references and notes, for readers coming to it without Ottoman Turkish.

one.title: One God, Many Prophets
one.blurb: A reading companion for the book: full text, a timeline, a glossary, an evidence matrix, and somewhere to keep your own notes.

check.title: Mîzan Muhasebesi
check.blurb: Forty questions for taking your own account before it's taken for you. Turkish, offline, and the answers never leave the device.

Readytodie.title: Ready to Die?
Readytodie.blurb: A confronting set of questions about what you'd leave unfinished, and what the afterlife would make of it.

testforge.title: TestForge
testforge.blurb: A control plane for hardware and firmware test labs: see which devices are healthy, queue jobs across them, and triage crashes without SSHing into anything.

AdilStore.title: AdilStore
AdilStore.blurb: A small app store for software that doesn't harvest you — handpicked tools, mindful games and spiritual companions, with the privacy terms stated up front.

adilstore-webapps.title: AdilStore Web Apps
adilstore-webapps.blurb: The hosted web builds behind AdilStore — the versions that run in a browser tab with nothing to install.

Benefisocial.title: SoBeneficial
Benefisocial.blurb: A social network designed around communities that teach and support rather than feeds that enrage. This is the case for it, in English and Turkish.

soundscope.title: SoundScope
soundscope.blurb: Turn your phone into a sound-level meter and find out whether the room you're in is quietly damaging your hearing. Installs as an app, works offline.

coin.title: TimeCoin
coin.blurb: An experiment in using hours as the unit of exchange instead of currency.
